accuracy_notes: WBSC Official Rules of Softball 2026–2029, Fast Pitch, ball specification: 11 7/8–12 1/8 in, and at least 88 stitches on each cover using two needles. This task specifies the decimal range 11.88–12.13 in; its exact midpoint 12.005 in = 304.927 mm is used (within the official range). The WBSC stitch wording concerns flat seam style; the task requests raised stitches, represented here with the same 88-location two-needle construction. Cover pattern and six-sided thread are original approximations; no hidden core or individual fibers. Measured extents include raised seams/threads; nominal diameter describes the skin. Fine grain is normal detail only. Source: https://static.wbsc.org/uploads/federations/0/cms/documents/b5f6e3da-619d-2aa4-0d25-2ec00549b45d.pdf
